title: Measures to Ensure Stable Motorcycle COE Prices
what_it_is: Measures to Ensure Stable Motorcycle COE Prices

sections.label: Motorcycle ARF changes and COE supply
sections.summary: Feedback says the market is in flux after ARF changes; higher-end motorcycles cost more, lower-end ones are unaffected, and Category D COE contributions to the Open Category stopped in May.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The feedback was that the market is still in a state of flux and will take some time to stabilise following the recent Additional Registration Fee (ARF) changes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These ARF changes will make higher end motorcycles more expensive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, lower end motorcycles, which constitute more than 60% of the market, are unaffected and continue to attract an ARF of only 15% of the Open Market Value.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Furthermore, we had stopped the contribution of COEs from Category D to the Open Category since May, which will result in a larger supply of motorcycle COEs.

sections.label: Motorcycle COE category splitting concerns
sections.summary: Motorcycles are in a separate COE category so buyers need not compete with car buyers, but splitting Category D further could shrink quotas and increase volatility in quota and prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But let me reiterate that motorcycles currently are in a separate COE category so that motorcycle buyers need not compete with car buyers for COEs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: However, splitting Category D further would result in a much smaller quota available in each sub-category and this may lead to more volatility in the quota as well as the prices.
